about: The entry size bound (32768 bytes) is of the entry as a record carries it: encode the entry as compact JSON with HTML escaping off, marshal that text as a JSON string (as a record body is), and drop the two quotes. So a plain ASCII byte costs 1, '<' '>' '&' cost 6 (\u003c, \u003e, \u0026), a double quote or a backslash costs 4 (\\\" and \\\\), a control character 7 (\\u0001; U+2028 and U+2029 too), other characters their UTF-8 bytes. Here 8192 of any of '<' '&' '"' '\\' is over the bound and invalid; 4000 '<', 5400 '>', 7000 '"' and 7000 '\\' apply.
name: 33_the_size_bound_is_of_the_carried_form
